approach: Execute the unchanged V1E 15-condition matrix for 64 independent seeds using eight OMP=1 CPU reference processes. The sample size is the next power of two above V1ED's one-sided 90% upper-SD requirement of 61.
runtime_basis: Scaling V1E's 103.51 CPU-hours and 14.64 wall-hours by 64/20 estimates 331.23 CPU-hours and 46.85 wall-hours at the same observed throughput; the design-time ideal estimate is 41.40 wall-hours.
storage_estimate: Approximately 160 GB; umi /home had about 13 TB free at freeze time and all heavy artifacts remain under the ignored workspace.
evidence_boundary: V1F can validate calibration premises only and cannot support a landscape-effect claim.
